critical_findings.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Read/Execute
critical_findings.description: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary files can be read and executed via HTTP request
critical_findings.fix: Disable UI server in production; bind to localhost; upgrade to vitest@4.1.10+

critical_findings.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
critical_findings.description: Arbitrary code execution via unsafe code generation from untrusted proto definitions (multiple vectors)
critical_findings.fix: Upgrade dockerode from 4.0.4 to 5.0.1+ (breaking change, requires testing)

high_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal in Optimized Deps
high_findings.description: Path traversal in .map file handling allows reading source maps from dev server

high_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection
high_findings.description: CRLF injection in form-data multipart field names and filenames allows header injection

high_findings.title: ws Uninitialized Memory Disclosure & DoS
high_findings.description: Uninitialized buffer memory leaked via WebSocket frames; unbounded buffering from tiny fragments

high_findings.title: React Router Protocol-Relative URL Open Redirect
high_findings.description: Routes with // paths treated as protocol-relative URLs causing open redirect to attacker domain

high_findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js Server Crash on Malformed Requests
high_findings.description: Malformed requests or compressed messages cause unhandled crashes

high_findings.title: path-to-regexp Regular Expression Denial of Service
high_findings.description: ReDoS via multiple route parameters; attacker crafts pathological input for regex backtracking
